title: CAPTCHA Verification System
summary: The CAPTCHA check shown while hunting to prevent abnormal play.

blocks.text: The NEED server uses a CAPTCHA verification system to prevent abnormal auto-hunting and macro use.

blocks.title: A check for normal play
blocks.text: A CAPTCHA can appear even during normal play. Enter the characters shown on the screen within the time limit to pass.
A CAPTCHA window can appear while hunting under certain conditions. It is not meant to punish any particular player: it checks for long repeated hunting and abnormal automated play.
When the CAPTCHA window appears, enter the characters shown in the image. The answer may be case-sensitive, so type it exactly as shown.

blocks.title: Time limit
blocks.text: The CAPTCHA must be entered within the time limit. Going over the limit may count as a failure.
Passing the CAPTCHA gives 1 Mythril Coin as a reward for normal play. 1 Mythril Coin can be exchanged for 500 Cash.
Repeated wrong answers or timeouts may flag you as a suspected macro user. To limit the damage from honest mistakes, this currently sends you to jail instead of an immediate permanent ban.

blocks.title: Please note
blocks.text: A CAPTCHA can appear even during normal play. When it does, stay calm and enter the characters on the screen. Failing repeatedly may lead to sanctions.
The CAPTCHA trigger rate, reward and sanction criteria may be adjusted depending on the server situation.
